indication: Colorectal cancer with peritoneal metastases (CRS + HIPEC)
intervention: HIPEC with 5-FU, irinotecan, or oxaliplatin after cytoreductive surgery
inclusion_match_notes: Randomised phase 3 in colorectal peritoneal metastases comparing CRS alone vs CRS + HIPEC. The patient has resectable peritoneal disease with planned CRS-HIPEC, so this is a direct sequencing trial for the upcoming surgical window. Eligibility is anatomic/PCI-driven, not biomarker-driven.
intervention_dosing: HIPEC per local protocol (5-FU IV intra-op + IP oxaliplatin or irinotecan)

inclusion_match_notes: CAIRO6 randomizes patients with isolated resectable CRC peritoneal metastases to perioperative systemic therapy plus CRS-HIPEC vs CRS-HIPEC alone. The patient's disease pattern (peritoneal-only after liver met resection, FOLFIRI-bev in progress) maps onto this trial's enrollment population.
intervention_dosing: FOLFOX or FOLFOXIRI ± bevacizumab pre-op for 6 cycles

indication: Peritoneal carcinomatosis from CRC and appendiceal cancer (PIPAC)
intervention: Pressurized intraperitoneal aerosol chemotherapy (PIPAC) with oxaliplatin or 5-FU + concurrent systemic chemo
inclusion_match_notes: City of Hope PIPAC platform for CRC peritoneal disease. The patient is potentially eligible after the planned CRS-HIPEC if peritoneal recurrence develops, or if CRS-HIPEC is deferred and PIPAC is pursued instead. Fit becomes strong if upfront CRS-HIPEC is not pursued.
intervention_dosing: PIPAC oxaliplatin 92 mg/m2 IP aerosol q6wk

inclusion_match_notes: Hong Kong PIPAC programme open to colorectal peritoneal disease. Geographically distant from a US patient (geography_band: US) but documents the broader PIPAC landscape; fit is weak on access alone.

intervention: Flat-dose mitomycin C HIPEC vs weight-based mitomycin C HIPEC
inclusion_match_notes: University of Kentucky randomized HIPEC dosing trial. Relevant if the surgical team chooses mitomycin C HIPEC over oxaliplatin (the latter became the dominant regimen after PRODIGE 7). The patient pre-FOLFIRI exposure is irrelevant to MMC dosing strategy.
intervention_dosing: Mitomycin C HIPEC, flat dose vs weight-based

intervention: Mass-based response drug screening to personalise HIPEC regimen
inclusion_match_notes: Yale feasibility trial uses an ex-vivo MRT device on resected tumor to choose the HIPEC agent. Relevant for personalising mitomycin vs oxaliplatin vs irinotecan IP — TOP1 amp would intuitively favor irinotecan HIPEC, BCL2L1 amp does not directly inform agent choice. Worth flagging to the surgical PI.

indication: Locally advanced CRC with peritoneal metastases (neoadjuvant)
inclusion_match_notes: Spanish phase 3 of neoadjuvant systemic therapy with or without HIPEC for locally advanced CRC. The patient's setting (metastatic peritoneal disease, already on systemic 1L) is adjacent — would require local-PI judgment about whether the patient maps to this trial's locally-advanced cohort.
sponsor: Maimónides Biomedical Research Institute of Córdoba

indication: RAS-mutated GI solid tumors (CRC, PDAC) — RASolve GI platform
biomarker: RAS mutation (subprotocols A/B accept any RAS-mutated CRC; D/E/F gate on KRAS G12D)
intervention: RMC-6236 (daraxonrasib) ± bevacizumab or cetuximab + FOLFOX/FOLFIRI; RMC-9805 for G12D arms
inclusion_match_notes: RMC-6236 is a RAS(ON) multi-selective inhibitor with the broadest mechanism for KRAS A59T among current RAS-targeted programs. The protocol-level eligibility text says RAS-mutated CRC; sponsor-level definition usually limits to codons 12/13/61. Fit becomes strong only if the sponsor confirms A59T as eligible via local-PI inquiry — this is the highest-yield single inquiry on the case.
intervention_dosing: RMC-6236 PO QD on 28-day cycles, ± bev / cetuximab / FOLFOX / FOLFIRI

indication: Advanced solid tumors with RAS mutations (codons 12, 13, 61)
inclusion_match_notes: The flagship RMC-6236 monotherapy basket. Eligibility text explicitly restricts to codons 12/13/61, which excludes the patient's KRAS A59T on protocol-defined criteria. Listed for the dossier because RMC-6236 mechanism still plausibly targets A59T RAS biology; protocol amendment or sponsor exception would be required.

indication: Advanced solid tumors (PDAC, NSCLC, CRC) with RAS mutations
inclusion_match_notes: Pan-RAS program with the broadest published codon list (12/13/61/117/146). Still excludes A59T on literal eligibility. Worth tracking because the sponsor's definition of 'RAS alteration' may broaden in protocol amendments and this is one of the few programs with explicit codon-117/146 inclusion.

indication: Advanced solid tumors with KRAS alterations
inclusion_match_notes: Eligibility reads 'KRAS alterations' without codon restriction in the public protocol summary, and the exclusion criterion is prior G12C/G12D/pan-KRAS inhibitor therapy — A59T is therefore plausibly eligible. Fit becomes strong on sponsor confirmation. One of the strongest atypical-KRAS-friendly programs currently recruiting.

indication: RAS/MAPK mutation-positive solid tumors (NSCLC, CRC, PDAC, BTC, histiocytosis)
biomarker: KRAS, HRAS, NRAS, BRAF or CRAF mutations or alterations (codon-agnostic)
inclusion_match_notes: Eligibility lists 'KRAS, HRAS, NRAS, BRAF, and/or CRAF mutations or alterations' with no codon restriction. Part 1B (GI tumors) and Part 1D / 2B2 (CRC) cohorts are mechanism-of-action matches for KRAS A59T downstream ERK pathway dependence. Strong candidate for sponsor inquiry on A59T eligibility.

indication: Refractory RAS-mutated metastatic solid tumors (CRC, PDAC, NSCLC, melanoma)
biomarker: Documented RAS (KRAS, HRAS, NRAS) mutation — codon-agnostic
inclusion_match_notes: Russian phase 2 explicitly accepts any RAS (KRAS/HRAS/NRAS) mutation with no codon restriction. The patient meets the biomarker criterion on KRAS A59T. Geography (Russia) is a feasibility barrier for a US patient (geography_band: US); fit becomes strong on logistics only. Mechanism rationale is the MEK+autophagy synthetic-lethal hypothesis for RAS-mutant tumors.
intervention_dosing: Leflunomide PO daily, or MEK inh + HCQ ± bev

biomarker: KRAS G12D, G12R, G12V, G12A, G12C, G12S, G13D mutations
inclusion_match_notes: ELI-002 vaccine encodes seven specific KRAS peptides (G12D/V/R/A/C/S, G13D). KRAS A59T is not among them, so the patient is not biomarker-eligible. Listed for dossier completeness so the KRAS-vaccine landscape is visible to the board.

indication: Stage IV MMR-proficient CRC and PDAC
biomarker: One of the KRAS mutations included in the vaccine (G12C/G12D/G12V/G12R/G13D types)
intervention: KRAS peptide vaccine + Poly-ICLC + balstilimab + botensilimab
inclusion_match_notes: Vaccine encodes the common G12/G13 KRAS peptides; KRAS A59T is outside the encoded set, so biomarker eligibility fails. Listed because the bot/bal + KRAS-vaccine concept is the closest neoantigen-immunotherapy platform for MSS KRAS-mutant CRC at this institution.
intervention_dosing: KRAS peptide vaccine + Poly-ICLC adjuvant + bot/bal

biomarker: Cohort-specific (PIK3CA-mutant for inavolisib arms; KRAS G12C for divarasib arms)
intervention: Inavolisib + cetuximab; Inavolisib + bevacizumab; Divarasib + cetuximab ± FOLFOX/FOLFIRI; atezolizumab combos
inclusion_match_notes: INTRINSIC is the Roche-Genentech mCRC platform that uses FoundationOne CDx for biomarker assignment. PIK3CA M1043I should route the patient to the inavolisib + bevacizumab cohort. Bevacizumab continuation aligns with current 1L exposure. Strongest single drug-mechanism match for the PIK3CA axis.
intervention_dosing: Inavolisib 9 mg PO QD + bevacizumab 15 mg/kg IV Q3W (28-day cycle)

inclusion_match_notes: KCSG trial of alpelisib + capecitabine in PIK3CA-mutant mCRC. Status is 'unknown' on the registry, so currency is questionable. Mechanism (PI3K-alpha inhibition) directly targets PIK3CA M1043I. Listed as off-label-precedent for alpelisib in mCRC.
intervention_dosing: Alpelisib 300 mg PO QD + capecitabine 850-1000 mg/m2 BID

inclusion_match_notes: INAVO120 is the registrational PIK3CA-mutant breast-cancer trial that established inavolisib's PI3K-alpha-selective profile. Patient cannot enroll (CRC, not breast), but the row anchors inavolisib's PIK3CA-mutant pharmacology evidence base for off-label discussion. Cross-tumor mechanism evidence.
intervention_dosing: Inavolisib 9 mg PO QD + palbociclib + fulvestrant

biomarker: HER2 IHC 3+ or ISH amplified OR NGS amplification AND RAS wild-type
comparator: Standard of care (mFOLFOX6 + bev or anti-EGFR)
inclusion_match_notes: MOUNTAINEER-03 requires HER2-positive AND RAS wild-type. The patient has KRAS A59T (RAS-mutated), so RAS-WT criterion fails outright. HER2 status is pending; even if amplified, RAS criterion is the gating exclusion. Listed for completeness — fit could not become strong without KRAS A59T being formally classified as RAS-WT-equivalent, which is not current consensus.

biomarker: HER2+ (IHC 3+ or IHC 2+/ISH amplified, or NGS amplification) AND RAS-WT
inclusion_match_notes: MOUNTAINEER registrational trial. Same RAS-WT gating as MOUNTAINEER-03 — the patient's KRAS A59T excludes. The MOUNTAINEER ORR data established the off-label rationale for tuc+tras in HER2+ RAS-WT mCRC. Anchor row for the HER2 landscape evidence base.
intervention_dosing: Tucatinib 300 mg BID + trastuzumab 8→6 mg/kg Q3W

intervention: Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) 5.4 mg/kg vs 6.4 mg/kg Q3W
inclusion_match_notes: DESTINY-CRC02 allows RAS-mutant CRC, unlike the MOUNTAINEER series. If HER2 IHC returns 3+ or 2+/ISH+, this becomes the strongest single trial for the patient — the camptothecin payload also addresses the TOP1-amp rationale. Fit becomes strong if HER2 returns positive on the pending NGS / IHC.
intervention_dosing: T-DXd 5.4 mg/kg or 6.4 mg/kg IV Q3W

inclusion_match_notes: Emory neoadjuvant zanidatamab for HER2+ CRC pre-surgery. The patient already has metastatic disease (stage IV with peritoneal carcinomatosis), so the neoadjuvant-resectable population doesn't fit. Documents the HER2-bispecific landscape in CRC.
SHR-A1811 is a HER2-targeting ADC in 3L+ mCRC vs physician-choice late-line. HER2-positivity required per protocol — pending the patient's NGS update. Fit becomes partial if HER2 returns amplified.
Front-line T-DXd + cape + bev combination from GONO. Conditional fit — becomes partial if HER2 returns positive. Bevacizumab continuation aligns with current 1L. European trial; US access uncertain.

indication: Advanced solid tumors with TP53 Y220C mutation (PYNNACLE)
inclusion_match_notes: Rezatapopt is a Y220C-pocket-specific p53 reactivator. The patient's TP53 R273 (substitution unspecified) is not Y220C, so biomarker fails. Listed because the board needs to see the dedicated Y220C program exists and the patient is not eligible by allele.
intervention_dosing: Rezatapopt PO + pembrolizumab IV per protocol

indication: Solid tumors with TP53 mutation (bladder, gastric, NSCLC)
inclusion_match_notes: APR-246 is a broader-range mutant p53 reactivator (covenant binder via Y220 and adjacent pockets). Trial is completed without TP53-R273-specific data, but mechanism extrapolation supports off-label discussion. The Aprea program has wound down; listed as legacy mechanism evidence.

DT2216 is the BCL-xL-selective PROTAC degrader that spares platelets (vs navitoclax). The trial is in platinum-resistant ovarian, but BCL2L1 (BCL-xL) amplification is the patient's mechanism-of-action match. Off-label / compassionate-use discussion candidate if BCL-xL biology becomes actionable.

Pediatric COG trial of DT2216 plus irinotecan. The patient is 37 (outside the pediatric age window) and so cannot enroll. The combination is the most relevant published BCL-xL + TOP1 inhibitor combination — important precedent for the 20q11 BCL2L1+TOP1 co-amplification biology, which suggests sensitisation to irinotecan with BCL-xL blockade.
intervention_dosing: DT2216 IV weekly + irinotecan per pediatric schedule

indication: Relapsed/refractory solid tumors and hematologic malignancies
inclusion_match_notes: First-in-human DT2216 monotherapy trial; completed. Establishes DT2216 safety and BCL-xL-selectivity (platelet-sparing relative to navitoclax). The patient's BCL2L1 amplification is the mechanism rationale. Anchor row for the BCL-xL PROTAC class.

intervention: Navitoclax (ABT-263) monotherapy or combined with irinotecan or erlotinib
inclusion_match_notes: Completed navitoclax + irinotecan combination phase 1. Most directly published evidence for combining a BCL-xL inhibitor with irinotecan in solid tumors — relevant for the patient's BCL2L1 + TOP1 co-amplification biology. Navitoclax's thrombocytopenia signal explains the field's move to DT2216. Legacy mechanism evidence.

Pelcitoclax is a dual Bcl-2/Bcl-xL inhibitor (with the same on-target thrombocytopenia issue as navitoclax). Class evidence for BCL-xL inhibition in solid tumors. The patient's BCL2L1 amp makes this mechanism relevant; the program has slowed since 2023.

BREAKWATER is the BRAF V600E mCRC front-line registrational trial. The patient's BRAF status is 'not explicitly reported' but BRAF V600E + KRAS A59T co-occurrence is unusual. Fit becomes strong if BRAF V600E is confirmed on the pending NGS. Conditional row for the BRAF arm of the algorithm.
intervention_dosing: Encorafenib 300 mg PO QD + cetuximab 500 mg/m2 Q2W ± mFOLFOX6

inclusion_match_notes: Eligibility requires KRAS G12C; the patient has KRAS A59T which is not G12C. Listed as the cleanest 1L atypical-KRAS-adjacent precedent and to anchor the sotorasib + anti-EGFR backbone evidence base.

Divarasib is a more selective G12C-on inhibitor (vs sotorasib/adagrasib). Patient's KRAS A59T is not G12C, so biomarker fails. Anchor row because divarasib + cetuximab is also under study in INTRINSIC (NCT04929223) and the mechanism context is decision-relevant.
intervention_dosing: Divarasib PO + cetuximab / bevacizumab / atezolizumab per arm

inclusion_match_notes: CCTG phase 3 of bot/bal vs BSC in chemo-refractory MSS mCRC. The patient is MSS, currently 1L — fit becomes strong only at 3L+. Anchor trial for the bot/bal off-label-approval pathway.
intervention_dosing: Botensilimab + balstilimab IV Q3W or Q6W

intervention: Botensilimab + balstilimab + fasting-mimicking diet + vitamin C
inclusion_match_notes: USC phase 1 explicitly accepts 'any KRAS mutation' in MSS mCRC. The patient's KRAS A59T qualifies on protocol text. Bot/bal + fasting-mimicking diet + IV vitamin C is mechanistically novel; eligibility requires progression on fluoropyrimidine + oxaliplatin + irinotecan, so the patient needs to progress past 1L FOLFIRI-bev first. Fit becomes strongest at 2L+.
intervention_dosing: Bot 1 mg/kg + bal 3 mg/kg IV + FMD + IV vit C

inclusion_match_notes: Bot/bal + regorafenib in MSS mCRC after standard chemo. Patient is biomarker-eligible (MSS) but currently 1L; fit becomes strong at 2L+ after FOLFIRI-bev progression. Regorafenib carries a hand-foot / fatigue burden that should factor into the toxicity weighting.
intervention_dosing: Bot/bal IV + regorafenib 80-120 mg PO daily

indication: Non-MSI-H or pMMR CRC with liver metastases
inclusion_match_notes: MGH early-phase 1 of SBRT + bot/bal in MSS CRC with liver mets. The patient's liver mets are resected, so 'liver metastases' eligibility is uncertain — would depend on residual or recurrent liver disease. Mechanism (abscopal + dual ICI) is the leading MSS-CRC ICI hypothesis.
intervention_dosing: SBRT to liver lesion + bot/bal IV

inclusion_match_notes: Agenus-sponsored phase 2 of bot/bal in MSS mCRC. Fit becomes strong at 2L+ after FOLFIRI-bev progression. The Agenus program is the lead bot/bal registrational asset for MSS CRC.

3B-FOLFOX = chemo + bev + bot/bal in 1L MSS mCRC. The patient is already on FOLFIRI-bev as 1L, not FOLFOX; conversion to a 1L-bot/bal-FOLFOX cohort would require pause/switch logic, but the regimen concept maps cleanly onto the patient's setting.

Agenus expanded-access protocol for bot/bal before regulatory approval. Relevant compassionate-use channel if the patient progresses past FOLFIRI-bev and standard 2L/3L options are exhausted. Surfaces the off-trial access path for the bot/bal class.
SR-8541A is an ENPP1 inhibitor that boosts the STING pathway. Combined with bot/bal in MSS mCRC 3L+. The patient is currently 1L; fit becomes partial only after multiple lines of progression.

Chinese 3L+ trial of PD-1/CTLA-4 bispecific + fruquintinib + SBRT. The patient is 1L currently; mechanism (bispecific ICI + VEGFR TKI + abscopal radiation) is the MSS-CRC immune-priming hypothesis. US access via this trial is impractical.
intervention_dosing: Cadonilimab IV Q3W + fruquintinib 5 mg PO + SBRT
sponsor: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

inclusion_match_notes: Weill Cornell platform of bot/bal + AGEN1423 (CD73/TGF-beta trap bifunctional) + radiation for CRC liver mets. Patient's liver mets are resected — eligibility depends on liver recurrence. Mechanism overlap with SMAD4-loss / TGF-beta-axis biology makes this row decision-relevant.
LEAP-017 missed its OS endpoint in 3L+ mCRC. Listed for completeness of the MSS-CRC ICI + anti-angiogenic landscape. Mechanism extrapolation only — not a recommendation.
intervention_dosing: Lenvatinib 20 mg PO QD + pembrolizumab 400 mg IV Q6W

inclusion_match_notes: Chinese phase 3 testing HDAC inhibitor + PD-1 + bev vs fruquintinib in MSS CRC. Mechanism rationale is HDAC-driven immune priming of MSS tumors. US access not available.

indication: Locally advanced or metastatic low-tumor-volume CRC
inclusion_match_notes: NILK-2301 is a CEA-CD3 T-cell engager — a cibisatamab successor. Restricted to low-tumor-volume disease; patient's peritoneal carcinomatosis may exceed the LTV threshold. Mechanism (CEA-bispecific) is a candidate for post-HIPEC microscopic-disease control if MRD is detectable.

Early-phase GUCY2C CAR-T in digestive-tract tumors. Trial completed. Anchor row for the GUCY2C CAR landscape — relevant if the patient's tumor is GUCY2C-positive on IHC (most CRC adenocarcinomas express GUCY2C).

intervention: GRT-C901 + GRT-R902 personalized neoantigen vaccine + atezolizumab + ipilimumab + fluoropyrimidine-leucovorin
inclusion_match_notes: GRANITE-MSS / Gritstone GRT-C901/R902 personalised neoantigen vaccine in MSS mCRC 1L maintenance after induction chemo. The patient is on FOLFIRI-bev, so this is sequencing-adjacent if induction yields disease control. The Gritstone parent company filed for Chapter 11 in 2024 — program is now in caretaker status.
intervention_dosing: GRT-C901 prime + GRT-R902 boost + atezo + ipi + 5-FU/LV

intervention: Pembrolizumab + autologous dendritic cell vaccine followed by TAS-102 + bev
inclusion_match_notes: Italian phase 2 of sequential pembro + DC vaccine then TAS-102 + bev in MSS mCRC. Mechanism (autologous DC vaccine for MSS immune priming) is an alternative to off-the-shelf neoantigen platforms. EU-only access.
intervention_dosing: Pembrolizumab + autologous DC vaccine then TAS-102 + bev

inclusion_match_notes: FRESCO registrational trial — fruquintinib improved OS in 3L+ mCRC. Patient becomes eligible for fruquintinib (US-approved post-FRESCO-2 in 2023) only at 3L+. Mechanism is VEGFR1/2/3 selective TKI; does not directly target the patient's molecular features.
intervention_dosing: Fruquintinib 5 mg PO QD on days 1-21 of 28-day cycle

inclusion_match_notes: SUNLIGHT established TAS-102 + bev as standard 3L in mCRC. Patient becomes eligible at 3L+. Mechanism does not target the patient's specific features; included as the standard 3L scaffold.
intervention_dosing: Trifluridine/tipiracil 35 mg/m2 PO BID + bevacizumab 5 mg/kg IV Q2W

inclusion_match_notes: VELOUR established aflibercept + FOLFIRI as 2L after oxaliplatin-based 1L failure. The patient's 1L is FOLFIRI + bev, so aflibercept becomes relevant if the sequence shifts to FOLFOX 1L + FOLFIRI-aflibercept 2L. Mechanism is broader anti-VEGF (A/B/PlGF) than bev.

RAISE established ramucirumab (anti-VEGFR2) + FOLFIRI as a 2L option after bev-containing 1L. Similar logic to aflibercept; choice between the two is institutional. Mechanism does not directly target the patient's molecular features.

indication: Resected stage II/III/IV colon cancer (CIRCULATE-US / NRG-GI008)
inclusion_match_notes: CIRCULATE-US tests Signatera-guided adjuvant chemo in resected colon cancer. The patient's metastatic status makes the front-door cohort a mismatch, but post-CRS-HIPEC the patient enters an adjuvant-equivalent state — Signatera testing is decision-relevant for HIPEC sequencing and surveillance. Conditional fit on post-HIPEC enrollment.
intervention_dosing: ctDNA-guided mFOLFOX6 / CAPOX / mFOLFIRINOX per arm

inclusion_match_notes: MDACC feasibility study of ctDNA-tailored neoadjuvant therapy in CRC / appendiceal cancer. Mechanism-of-use rationale supports ctDNA monitoring across the planned CRS-HIPEC window. Fit is weak as a trial but the workflow it tests is decision-relevant.

indication: Advanced metastatic CRC and other solid tumors
biomarker: STAT3 / beta-catenin pathway alterations (APC, CTNNB1, AXIN1)
inclusion_match_notes: ST316 disrupts Wnt/beta-catenin/STAT3 signaling — relevant to the patient's APC E1295 (Wnt-pathway loss). Combination arms include FOLFIRI + bev and TAS-102 + bev, both of which align with the patient's likely sequence. APC E1295 is exactly the Wnt-loss biology the program targets.

indication: Metastatic colorectal cancer with dynamic resistance
intervention: ASCEND-CRC platform: SOC + bev / cetuximab / panitumumab / FOLFIRI rotation
inclusion_match_notes: MDACC ASCEND-CRC platform tracks resistance-mediated rotation across bev, anti-EGFR, and chemo backbones. The patient's KRAS A59T status would gate anti-EGFR eligibility on local interpretation. Adaptive platform — useful for the dossier as a research-grade longitudinal monitoring option.

Chinese 3L+ MET-amp / overexpression mCRC trial. The patient's NGS does not report MET status; the 20q11 amplification does not include MET. Listed only as a conditional row if a future biopsy reveals MET amplification.
